name: Mentalist - Rule-Based Wordlist Generator
description: Mentalist is a GUI tool for building targeted password wordlists from a base list using chained nodes: case changes, substitutions (leetspeak), prepend/append of years/numbers/symbols, and more. It visualizes the transformation pipeline and can export either the full wordlist or equivalent hashcat/John rules for on-the-fly mangling.
notes:
=== RUN ===
  mentalist          # launches the GUI (Python 3 + tkinter)

=== BUILD A CHAIN (nodes, top to bottom) ===
  1. Base Words      - import names/company terms/CeWL output/cupp seeds
  2. Case            - lowercase, UPPER, Capitalize, tOGGLE
  3. Substitution    - leet (a->@, s->$, e->3), custom maps
  4. Append/Prepend  - years (2023-2025), numbers 0-999, symbols (!, @, #)

=== EXPORT ===
  File > Save Wordlist      # the full expanded list
  File > Save Rules         # hashcat (.rule) / John rules to apply at crack time
  # rules are far smaller than a giant list -> feed to hashcat -r

=== TYPICAL USE ===
  # seed with CeWL of the target site + employee names, then mangle ->
  # targeted list for spraying or offline cracking

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  hashcat -r rules/best64.rule   # apply rules directly
  CeWL (scrape site words) ; cupp (profile a person) ; crunch (charset lists)

recommended.note: CeWL to scrape seed words from the target site.
cupp to profile an individual for seed terms.
Apply the exported rules in hashcat.

defense.why_it_works: Users build passwords from predictable bases (names, company, seasons, years) plus simple mutations. Mentalist encodes exactly those human patterns, so a small targeted list/ruleset covers a large share of real passwords.
defense.prerequisites: Seed words relevant to the target (OSINT, site scrape, employee names); the hashes or a login surface to attack.
defense.impact: High-yield targeted wordlists/rules that crack weak passwords faster than generic lists and improve spraying success.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1110.001] Offline cracking is not visible to the defender; online use shows as authentication failures. Detect spraying/brute-force (many failures across accounts, lockouts) rather than the list generation.
defense.artifacts: None for offline list building; online attempts produce auth-failure (4625/IdP) patterns.
defense.prevention: Enforce long passphrases and block common/base-word+mutation passwords (banned-password lists, Azure AD Password Protection); MFA; account lockout/throttling; detect spraying; discourage predictable patterns in policy.
